events.body:
## Context

`test/widget_test.dart` is Flutter's template counter test, which can't pass because the app has no counter. `lib/idle_detector.dart`, `lib/batch_sender.dart` and `lib/api_client.dart` (injectable `http.Client`) are pure Dart and untested. Needs the Flutter SDK.

## What to do

1. Delete the template test.
2. Add `idle_detector_test.dart` (fake_async), `batch_sender_test.dart` (flush at max size, re-queue on error) and `api_client_test.dart` (MockClient: 2xx, non-2xx, empty body).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] At least 8 tests
- [ ] No test loads the native X11 library

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-timer-flutter   # needs the Flutter SDK
```
